history.note: The code-only engine. It was tuned on development seeds 11 and 23 only and frozen before its one scoring on the held-out seeds.

Engine version 2. Version 1 dropped a clause that reads like a rule but matches no tracked rule's cue words, and the hand-written clauses showed that's where code misses silently (23 of 36). Version 2 sends those clauses to the rule extractor's queue and adds the role names by id for the prompt. Code's own findings are unchanged because the queue never makes a finding. It was tuned on development seeds 11 and 23 only. It was scored once on held-out set B (6101, 6202, and 6303) and never on the seeds version 1 was scored on.

note: Engine version 3. Version 2 was never scored. Version 3 names the side that narrows a variation's scope the way scope.deliberate found it. A variation's reason no longer reads None when an addendum narrows states while a policy narrows lines. Findings are unchanged. It was tuned on development seeds only and scored once on held-out set B.
